In a team with many members, the drawing becomes hard to read. You can give each member an icon, and put related members in a group. This changes only how the team looks: it does not change how the members work. It does not change what a member gives to the team either: its answer, and its named outputs. See [Use a team or a workflow as a member](/docs/teams/put-a-team-in-a-team/).

The name of a member is shown in the answer of a **Concurrent** team: each answer comes after the name of its member.

## What you need

- A team open in its editor, with its members. See [Create a team of agents](/docs/teams/create-a-team/).

## Open the window of a member

1. On the canvas, right-click the hexagon of the member.
2. Select **Edit**.

![The menu of a team member, opened with a right-click on its hexagon: Explain with the assistant, Improve with the assistant, Edit, Copy and Delete](images/member-menu.jpg)

A window opens with the name of the member and the line "How this member looks in this team."

The same menu has **Copy**, **Delete**, and two entries that open the Assistant on this member.

## Put members in a group

Members of a group are drawn together and share a colour. Use groups to show the parts of a team. For example, in a team that follows unpaid invoices: one group `Writing`, one group `Checks`.

1. In the window of the member, under **Group**, type the name of the group in **Name**.
2. Choose the **Color** of the group among the colours proposed, or select **Custom…** to choose another one.
3. Select **Save**.
4. Do the same for each member of the group, with exactly the same name.

![The window of the member Reminder Writer: under Group, the name Writing and a row of colours; under Icon, the button Change](images/member-window.jpg)

Leave **Name** empty for a member that belongs to no group.

## Give a member an icon

1. In the window of the member, under **Icon**, select **Change…**
2. Choose an icon.
3. Select **Save**.

The icon is shown on the hexagon of this member, in this team. The same agent can have another icon in another team.

## Remove a member

1. Right-click the hexagon.
2. Select **Delete**.

This removes the member from the team. The agent itself stays in your workspace.

## Save

Select **Publish**, at the top right.

## How to know it worked

On the canvas, the symbol of each member takes the colour of its group, and each member shows its icon.

![The team on the canvas: the symbol of Reminder Writer is orange, the colour of its group, and the symbol of Reminder Reviewer keeps the default colour](images/member-group.jpg)
